column1: # Proposed layout migration: source<TAB>destination, relative to repository root.
# REVIEW ONLY until reorganize_repository.sh is explicitly run with --apply.
# Moves preserve contents. Imports/links/commands are NOT rewritten.
# Figures, LaTeX trees, papers, caches, output/, src/output/ and .git stay put.
# current/ means the selected reference family; its prose is not yet consolidated.
# components/ are ACTIVE dependencies, not obsolete optimization notes.
# history/ preserves earlier variants; this manifest never deletes files.
